acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom framing can vary significantly based on design complexity, material choices, and local labor rates. While it's difficult to provide an exact per-square-foot cost without reviewing specific plans, custom framing typically falls within a range of $15 to $30 per square foot for labor and basic materials in the Pasadena area. Complex designs with intricate rooflines or high ceilings can incur higher costs.
